text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The two main suspects in the so-called National Housing Enterprise "Single Quarters Scam", suspended NHE chief executive officer Axaro Tsowaseb and Ignatius Bampton of Alba Construction, are appealing for bail.
- Tsumeb Corporation Ltd (TCL) is considering the contracting out of a number of non-core businesses, such as security, cleaning and health services after the recent retrenchment of 450 employees.
- The commission looking into working conditions of farm and house workers may call for a national minimum wage, according to its chairman Dr Zephania Kameeta.
- The appointment of former NBC (Namibian Broadcasting Corp) top man Tulionanae Emvula as a public service commissioner has cause controversy in the National Assembly.
